notes: Daily discharge, water year October 1953 to September 1954. Filled day cells: Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, June 30, July 31 = 212. Oct, Nov, Dec, Aug and Sept have no daily values printed (only '(*)' marks; monthly total and mean 0 = no flow all month); if those no-flow days are counted as measurements the total is 365. n_variables adds the Total / Mean / Ac-ft rows (12 x 3 = 36) and the 8 calendar-year and water-year summary values. No station number printed. Location text also says: in Paso de Robles Grant, on left bank 1.4 miles upstream from mouth, 1.8 miles northwest of Oakdale school, and 5.6 miles west of Templeton (a land grant, no township-range-section printed).
